description: Sets Autopilot on or off after explicit consent. On authorizes recurring real employer submissions under the account holder's name without per-application approval. Off stops sending and keeps the minimum match, resume choice and queue; paused is accepted and means off. Daily and monthly limits remain determined by the plan.

confirmationToken.description: Echo the token from a previous `held` result to carry out the act it described, and only after the person has seen that result's summary and agreed to it. Send identical arguments: the token is bound to the exact call it was issued for, so a changed argument is held again with a fresh token and a fresh summary. It lasts two minutes and is spent once.

name: set_autopilot
title: Turn Autopilot on or off
